text:
maya: Quick idea — can we add a tiny templating layer to deployflow so teams can attach "hooklets" per release? Reuse preflight/lint/rollback-checks instead of copy-pasting scripts.

sam: +1, been fighting duplicated preflight across services. How would hooklets get versioned/pinned?

jordan: Thinking: store hooklet YAML in repo, reference by sha or tag. deploy bot resolves hooklet -> runs on staging during preflight. Example:

jordan: ```yaml
hooklet: basic-preflight
version: v1.2.0
steps:
  - run: ./scripts/check-schema.sh
  - run: ./scripts/check-traffic-guards.sh
on_fail: notify-channel: # default to release-team
  - # short-circuit deploy
    action: abort
``` 

tess: Love it. We should allow an override param on /deploy so SRE can force-skip in emergencies: `/deploy canary --skip-hooklets` but log the skip and require approver.

deploy-bot: NOTICE: New command proposal received. Suggestion: `/deploy template apply --hooklet=repo:path#ref --pin-hooklet=sha --notes '...'` — auto-attaches hooklet run to preflight and stores hooklet sha in release metadata.

maya: For rollbacks: hooklets should be reversible (have a teardown step) or annotate rollback playbook with why failed so ops can pick safe rollback vs roll-forward.

sam: Implementation notes: provider repo for hooklets, small schema validation (name, version, steps[], on_fail). We can add `--dry-run-hooklet` which executes in a sandbox and emits a brief report.

jordan: Also suggest right-sized timeouts per hooklet and per-step, and automatic retry 2x for flaky infra checks.

tess: Action items: maya to draft the hooklet schema, sam to sketch deploy-bot CLI flags, jordan to prototype runner shim. I'll schedule a 30m sync Thu 10am to align.

maya: Thanks — I'll put a PR draft in infra/hooklets and tag you all. :rocket:
